Figure 2:Overview ofAnTrap. (a) Original Environment: a base emulator that supports parallel evaluation over base tasks and environments. (b)AnTrapConstruction: during dynamic execution, we intercept the agent’s⟨S,T,A⟩\langle S,T,A\rangleloop and inject four-layer anomalies through the trap toolbox. (c) Diversity Settings: trap type, injection timing, frequency, and content source can be flexibly configured to create diverse and realistic dynamic traps.
